decisions: 2026-10-03 operator correction: the application itself is the product. product.html and disconnected calculators are prototypes, not completion of the mission.

Triad and Aegis independently consume Core. Triad chooses its own design and builds missing product tools and spaces. No Aegis dependency, broker credential grant, or live-trading authority is implied.
Core SDK connection is demonstrated on explicit synthetic fixtures. It does not connect the existing CSV tools, certify real data, supply stored research or create the user-facing trading workflow.
Dataset endpoint is /triad/product-api/research/dataset-preparation under the existing mount.

Raw SHA-256 hashes exact submitted UTF-8. Prepared SHA-256 hashes schema_version, owner, metadata, window and normalized rows using sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False and allow_nan=False.

Unchanged inspector trims BOM/whitespace, normalizes UTC, formats exact decimal strings retaining trailing zeros and sorts timestamp then symbol. No gap filling or dropped rows; floats appear only at SDK boundary.

Explicit caller confirmation of one-minute XNYS REGULAR USD equity UNADJUSTED declarations is required before constructing Core input. Unconfirmed or Core-rejected structural rows remain inspectable without Core export.
No source certification, strategy-performance, persistence or execution claims. Independent QA is required before merge.

Executed candidate unit and Chromium integration checks cover inspection, preparation, chart/download consumption and real owner-scoped Core validation. TESTED denotes executed development evidence, not independent QA approval.
